svg.title: Part 2 search for a filled 3x3 block of robots
svg.desc: The simulation stops at the first second in which some robot is the top-left corner of a 3 by 3 block completely covered by robots, which happens when they draw the picture.

g.text: Part 2: look for a solid 3 × 3 block
searchShape checks the 9 cells starting at each occupied position
random robots rarely fill a 3 × 3 block; the picture of the tree does (made-up picture)
